scenarios.title: Get Auth Token
scenarios.description: Obtain a dual-token pair (AccessToken 15 min + RefreshToken 7 days). Store the access_token in memory and use it in the Authorization header for all subsequent requests.

snippets.curl:
# ── Auth: Get Token ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
curl -s -X POST "https://api.sandbox.example.com/auth/login" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"user_id": "alice", "role": "user"}'

# Tip: pipe to jq for pretty output
# curl ... | jq '.data.access_token'
snippets.python:
# ── Auth: Get Token (requests) ───────────────────────────────────────
import requests

BASE_URL = "https://api.sandbox.example.com"

def get_token(user_id: str = "alice", role: str = "user") -> dict:
    resp = requests.post(
        f"{BASE_URL}/auth/login",
        json={"user_id": user_id, "role": role},  # role is optional
        timeout=10,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()  # raises HTTPError for 4xx/5xx
    data = resp.json()["data"]
    print(f"Access token expires in {data['expires_in']}s")
    return data

token_pair = get_token()
access_token = token_pair["access_token"]  # use this in Authorization header
refresh_token = token_pair["refresh_token"]  # use this to refresh when expired
snippets.php:
<?php
// ── Auth: Get Token (Guzzle) ─────────────────────────────────────────
require 'vendor/autoload.php';

use GuzzleHttp\Client;

$BASE_URL = 'https://api.sandbox.example.com';
$client = new Client(['base_uri' => $BASE_URL]);

function getToken(Client $client, string $userId = 'alice', string $role = 'user'): string {
    $response = $client->post('/auth/login', [
        'json' => [
            'user_id' => $userId,
            'role'    => $role,   // optional: 'user' | 'admin'
        ],
    ]);

    // Guzzle throws GuzzleException on non-2xx
    $body = json_decode($response->getBody()->getContents(), true);
    return $body['data']['access_token'];
}

$accessToken = getToken($client);
echo "Token: " . substr($accessToken, 0, 20) . "...\n";

scenarios.title: Create a Product
scenarios.description: Create a new product in your sandbox namespace. The product is scoped to your user_id (extracted from the JWT). Requires a valid Access Token in the Authorization header.

snippets.curl:
# ── Create Product ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Replace <token> with the access_token from POST /auth/login
TOKEN="<your_access_token>"

curl -s -X POST "https://api.sandbox.example.com/api/v1/products" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Mechanical Keyboard",
    "sku":  "KB-001",
    "price": 2990.00
  }'
snippets.python:
# ── Create Product (requests) ────────────────────────────────────────
import requests

BASE_URL = "https://api.sandbox.example.com"

def create_product(access_token: str, name: str, sku: str, price: float) -> dict:
    headers = {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {access_token}",  # <── attach token
        "Content-Type":  "application/json",
    }
    payload = {"name": name, "sku": sku, "price": price}

    resp = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/api/v1/products", json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=10)

    if resp.status_code == 401:
        raise Exception("Token expired. Refresh it with POST /auth/refresh.")
    resp.raise_for_status()

    return resp.json()["data"]

# Usage (get token first, then create product)
product = create_product(
    access_token=access_token,  # from get_token() above
    name="Mechanical Keyboard",
    sku="KB-001",
    price=2990.00,
)
print(f"Created product: {product['id']}")
snippets.php:
<?php
// ── Create Product (Guzzle) ──────────────────────────────────────────
require 'vendor/autoload.php';

use GuzzleHttp\Client;

$client = new Client(['base_uri' => 'https://api.sandbox.example.com']);

function createProduct(Client $client, string $accessToken, string $name, string $sku, float $price): array {
    $response = $client->post('/api/v1/products', [
        'headers' => [
            'Authorization' => 'Bearer ' . $accessToken,  // <── attach token
            'Content-Type'  => 'application/json',
        ],
        'json' => [
            'name'  => $name,
            'sku'   => $sku,
            'price' => $price,
        ],
    ]);

    return json_decode($response->getBody()->getContents(), true)['data'];
}

// Usage
$token   = getToken($client);  // from previous snippet
$product = createProduct($client, $token, 'Mechanical Keyboard', 'KB-001', 2990.00);
echo "Created: " . $product['id'] . "\n";

scenarios.title: List Products
scenarios.description: Retrieve a paginated list of products in your sandbox namespace. Supports cursor-based pagination via the `next_cursor` field in the response. Results are scoped to your user_id (from the JWT).

snippets.curl:
# ── List Products ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
TOKEN="<your_access_token>"

curl -s "https://api.sandbox.example.com/api/v1/products?limit=10" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"

# With cursor pagination (get next page)
curl -s "https://api.sandbox.example.com/api/v1/products?limit=10&cursor=<next_cursor>" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
snippets.php:
<?php
// ── List Products (Guzzle) ───────────────────────────────────────────
require 'vendor/autoload.php';

use GuzzleHttp\Client;

$client = new Client(['base_uri' => 'https://api.sandbox.example.com']);

function listProducts(Client $client, string $accessToken, int $limit = 10, ?string $cursor = null): array {
    $query = ['limit' => $limit];
    if ($cursor !== null) $query['cursor'] = $cursor; // append cursor for next page

    $response = $client->get('/api/v1/products', [
        'headers' => ['Authorization' => 'Bearer ' . $accessToken],
        'query'   => $query,
    ]);

    return json_decode($response->getBody()->getContents(), true)['data'];
    // Returns: ['items' => [...], 'next_cursor' => '...', 'count' => 10]
}

// Fetch all pages
function fetchAllProducts(Client $client, string $accessToken): array {
    $all = [];
    $cursor = null;
    do {
        $page   = listProducts($client, $accessToken, 10, $cursor);
        $all    = array_merge($all, $page['items']);
        $cursor = $page['next_cursor'] ?? null; // null = last page
    } while ($cursor !== null);
    return $all;
}

$token    = getToken($client);  // from previous snippet
$products = fetchAllProducts($client, $token);
echo "Total: " . count($products) . " products\n";
